observations: body (Virgo 11): the dash before «Magnitudo» is printed broken in two pieces.
body (Sagittarius 7, Pisces 5): «Vh» before the semicolon and «5» are printed without a period.
body (Sagittarius 16): «Hg» is printed in italic, the period upright; a speck is printed after «que» (L1) and under the 4 of «274°» (L2); not transcribed.
body (Aquarius 3, 8): the two points after «tres» are printed spaced; the opening « of Aquarius 8 is printed broken.

body (Pisces 6): «سٮر» is printed without dots (sīn, one tooth, rāʾ); in «سيز» the dots of yāʾ are printed merged into a stroke; «سلر» (337, as in Pegasus 8, p. 279) is printed with the zāy without its dot.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
